title: Open the Combination Lock

monster.name: Cipher Gargoyle
monster.title: Guardian of Rotational Tumblers
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum 4-wheel tumbler turns to avoid deadends and reach target!

description: You have a lock in front of you with 4 circular wheels. Each wheel has 10 slots: '0'-'9'. The lock starts at '0000'. You are given a list of `deadends` strings. If the lock displays any of these codes, the lock becomes dead and cannot be turned. Given a `target`, return the minimum total number of turns required to open the lock, or -1 if impossible.
starterCode:
def openLock(deadends: list[str], target: str) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def openLock(deadends: list[str], target: str) -> int:
    dead = set(deadends)
    if "0000" in dead: return -1
    if target == "0000": return 0
    from collections import deque
    q = deque([("0000", 0)])
    visited = set(["0000"])
    while q:
        curr, d = q.popleft()
        if curr == target: return d
        for i in range(4):
            digit = int(curr[i])
            for delta in (-1, 1):
                nxt_digit = (digit + delta) % 10
                nxt = curr[:i] + str(nxt_digit) + curr[i+1:]
                if nxt not in dead and nxt not in visited:
                    visited.add(nxt)
                    q.append((nxt, d + 1))
    return -1
hints: Treat each 4-digit string as a node with 8 neighbors in a BFS shortest path search.
